messages:
Helen: Heads-up — we have a planned rolling reboot for eu-west1 GPU pool to apply the NIC/kernel egress fix. Window: 2024-06-12 02:00–04:00 UTC. Plan: cordon/drain 8–10 nodes at a time, reboot, uncordon. Expected impact: brief cold KV cache misses and ~3–5% capacity reduction during the window.

Raj: Can you call out the warmup and batching plan? Last time we saw a spike in tail latency due to KV eviction.

Helen: Good call. We'll pre-warm prefix/KV caches and run a low-rate warmup traffic job before uncordoning. Batching will be temporarily reduced from 32->16 for 15m after each node comes back to reduce latencies.

Ori: What's the exact drain command and warmup script? Share so infra can run it if needed.

Helen: Use the standard cordon/drain sequence:

```
# cordon + drain (example)
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
```

Warmup (will run from maintenance bastion):

```
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $MAINT_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}' >/dev/null
  sleep 0.5
done
```

This will refill shared KV prefixes and steady the KV miss rate.

Leon: We'll need an abort criteria. Last window we continued with degraded capacity and that hurt customers. My ask: pause if active GPU capacity drops below 85% or error rate >2% for 5m.

Helen: Agreed. Abort-if: capacity <85% OR 5m rolling error rate >2% on production routes. We'll also have an automated knob to increase traffic to dedicated reserved capacity in us-west if backfill is required.

Maria: I'll update the status page and alert channels. Can you add a note about model-fallback routing so SRE knows where traffic will route?

Helen: Yes: traffic fallback -> small-latency model variant (gpt-micro) in same region, then remote region fallback. We'll document in the incident runbook.

DevEx: I'll push a short runbook snippet to docs and post the maintenance banner. Also double-check SDK retries/respect timeouts.

SRE-Bot: Scheduled maintenance posted to #announcements: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/announcements/p1748000000000000

Raj: Cost note — warmup traffic will add ~0.5% token spend during the window. We're ok given the reliability benefit. Keeping you posted.

Helen: Thanks all. We'll start pre-warm 15m before the first cordon and monitor the dashboards. Ping here if you see anything off during the window. :thumbsup:
